Black Forest Labs (Portfolio founders)

In this era of upheaval, obsession beats playbooks, ambition beats size and conviction beats consensus. We back those who run toward the fire and follow one simple rule: connecting the top 0.1% with the top 0.1%.

We believe that rather than access to large in-house teams, what the top 0.1% of founders need is a connection to the top 0.1% of experts across adjacent industries – people who’ve built, scaled and broken new ground.

You go big by learning from those who have done it before you. This is where our Visionaries cadre comes in: many are our LPs, and they come to the table as mentors, early customers and collaborators.

Luminary founders: The people behind companies like UiPath, Miro, FlixBus, Lovable, n8n, Spotify, Personio, Adyen and HelloFresh, Hugging Face or DeepMind – operators who’ve been through the journey and are ready to help others do the same.

Industrial family entrepreneurs: Leaders of companies such as Swarovski, Mittal, Haniel, Stihl, Henkel, Siemens, Oetker, Fiege and Bitburger. Together, they represent over 90% of Europe’s most influential industrial families – and give our founders a direct route to enterprise customers and unique market insights.

Join the cadre

The Visionaries Era: Hungry beats big.

We burned the map.

We're in the middle of the fastest transformation any of us will ever witness. The old frameworks are being shredded to pieces. Anyone who tells you they know what comes next is fooling themselves.

We don’t pretend to have all the answers.
What we know is this: in every era of upheaval, one thing has mattered more than any other. Not capital, thesis or strategy.


The person. The one who wakes up obsessed, works with Herculean power, and still goes to sleep unsatisfied, having yet more to offer to this world.


AI will flatten every advantage except that one.

So we're doing the one thing we know how to: We back those who run toward the fire. 


And we run toward it ourselves. Every morning, we wake up with one ambition: to build the defining venture firm of this era. Not on the back of past laurels.


Because in moments of reset, the future doesn’t care that much about our past.

Instead, our edge comes from the same force we look for in founders: Obsession.


Because in every generational shift:
Obsession beats playbooks.
Ambition beats size.
Conviction beats consensus.

Hungry beats big.

We reject the institutional bloat that defines much of today’s VC industry.

Multistage firms have industrialised venture, scaling VC platforms like tech companies. But no amount of scaling can take away from the fact that venture is an outlier business. 

So we follow one very simple rule:
Connecting the top 0.1% with the top 0.1%.
The founders redefining the future deserve nothing less than those who have already built it once.

That’s why we are backed by a select group of the world’s most iconic entrepreneurs from tech to industry.

Our Tech Entrepreneurs, the founders and operators behind companies like Lovable, Hugging Face, UiPath, DeepMind, Miro, Adyen, Spotify, FlixBus or Personio have just been through your journey and are ready to help you do the same. They do not stand at the sidelines, but come from the trenches. They’ve felt the weight of responsibility, the adrenaline of product launches, the grind of global expansion, and the pain of near-failure.


Our Industrial Family Entrepreneurs such as Swarovski, Mittal, Haniel, Stihl, Henkel, Siemens, Oetker, Fiege or Viessmann give our founders direct access to over 90% of the most consequential industrial family businesses and with that, an unfair head start in product validation, procurement cycles and scaling in an AI world where speed matters more than ever before.

Together with these minds, we are building a fundamentally new model of venture for the most tectonic shift in the history of technology:

The Visionaries.

Lovable

Lovable is a Stockholm-based company building the last piece of software — a tool that lets anyone create an app simply by describing it with words. No code or complexity needed.

Website Link

Our Thesis

The internet made distributing digital products cheaper than ever. But building them is still expensive, slow, and bottlenecked by limited engineering resources. Lovable flips this on its head. By enabling anyone to create web apps using natural language, it collapses the cost of building software to near zero. That changes everything. We’re excited to see how this shift will unleash a new generation of entrepreneurs, indie builders, and businesses — all powered by AI. The barriers are gone. Now, it’s just about what you can imagine, create and build. Seeing is believing — try it now!

Pigment

Pigment is the all-in-one business and forecasting platform that allows companies to take better decisions collectively, run operations and plan ahead in a single source of truth tool as they scale.

Website Link

Our Thesis

Our investment decision into Pigment has been driven by our core hypothesis of digital tools empowering the decentralization of work. We believe work is getting increasingly digital, distributed, and more complex meaning that people need better tools to do their jobs. After the popularity and unbundling of highly verticalized solutions, e.g. Notion, Zoom, Slack, G-Suite, Trello / Asana, Affinity, Miro, Evernote, etc. now the focus lies on achieving full frictionlessness. Workflows that used to be executed inefficiently with multiple isolated tools can now be integrated, automated, or replaced with a more efficient single tool.

Our Thesis

We are in the middle of the full vertical and horizontal integration of new tech layers for SMEs. The target group is especially attractive as in many cases there is nothing to replace (e.g. Personio targeting greenfield/MS Excel). We strongly believe in the category of a new generation of lean software tools empowering micro SMEs, as it is the most underserved category regarding professional software, while at the same time the largest and fastest-growing market in terms of numbers of businesses. n8n

n8n is the AI orchestration platform that helps enterprises turn intelligence into impact. It connects large language models, business tools, and data sources into seamless, secure workflows. With a visual interface, pre-built integrations, and code-optional flexibility, n8n enables teams to automate, integrate, and scale complex processes reclaiming time, reducing costs, and driving real productivity gains.

Website Link

Our Thesis

Our investment in n8n is grounded in our belief that the next phase of AI will be defined not by model breakthroughs, but by orchestration. As enterprises race to embed AI into daily workflows, the winners will be those who can integrate intelligence securely, flexibly, and collaboratively across teams and systems. After a decade of tool fragmentation, from the rise of vertical productivity apps like Notion, Slack, and Asana, the pendulum is swinging toward orchestration and interoperability. n8n embodies this shift: it’s the connective tissue that unites people, data, and AI. By reducing handoffs, accelerating experimentation, and empowering every team to operationalise AI, n8n is building the infrastructure for enterprise-grade intelligence - one workflow at a time. Try it out here: https://n8n.io/

Tacto

Tacto is focusing on becoming the procurement operating system for SMEs by developing an AI-based software that gives customers a transparent overview of their procurement activities, algorithmically highlights risk & savings potential, and automates all transactional workflows in sourcing and supplier management.

Website Link

Our Thesis

We believe re-inventing the enterprise B2B IT stack is the here-and-now opportunity in Europe as everything that can be digitised. There is no economic reason for any part of the value chain not to be digitized in the long run if there is potential to streamline and automate processes. From developer tools to vertical-specific applications, we expect software to power all areas of business. Existing software architectures are going to shift towards more modular, consumerized and integrated solutions. Industrial procurement is one of the largest under-digitized markets. Our investment decision in Tacto has been mainly driven by building a tool that re-invents procurement for SMEs by bridging the information asymmetry between the supply and demand side in a digital platform automating transactional workflows across the supply chain.

Black Forest Labs

Founded by a small group of pioneering researchers in 2024, Black Forest Labs (BFL) has rapidly become one of the most advanced independent AI research organisations in the world, achieving frontier-level performance, validated by broad adoption and measurable global scale. Deeply rooted in foundational research, Black Forest Labs continuously builds state-of-the-art technology to empower creators, developers, and forward-thinking enterprises to bring their imagination to life. The BFL team pioneered Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX- milestones that transformed generative AI and made frontier image generation accessible to millions.

Website Link

Our Thesis

Black Forest Labs combines frontier level research with a practical and responsible approach to real world deployment. The team has reached a level of performance that rivals the largest global labs while remaining lean, focused, and committed to open accessibility. We were especially drawn to three things: a world class team that has already shaped a generation of visual AI technology, a model that blends open research with commercial adoption across both global enterprises and independent creators, and a European base with genuine global reach. This combination of scientific excellence, disciplined execution, and broad accessibility positions Black Forest Labs to define the next era of AI model development.

Tandem Health

The AI operating system for modern medicine.

Website Link

Our Thesis

Healthcare is breaking away from outdated systems, and Tandem is at the forefront of this shift. Clinicians today waste nearly half their time on admin. It’s inefficient, exhausting, and expensive. AI-native platforms are about to change that, and Tandem is building the one clinicians actually want to use. We believe AI medical assistants will become the invisible backbone of modern healthcare, streamlining workflows, cutting costs, and giving time back to the people who save lives. Born in the Nordics and built by healthcare insiders, Tandem is led by CEO Lukas Saari and Co-Founder Oscar Boldt-Christmas (formerly head of McKinsey’s European Healthcare practice). The company already powers more than 1,000 healthcare organisations, and a major partnership with Accurx is bringing its assistant to 200,000+ NHS professionals, one of the largest real-world AI deployments in global healthcare. Tandem is building a clinical co-pilot that supports medical teams directly and scales like software, automating documentation, referrals, follow-ups, and care coordination in seconds, not hours. We're excited to back the foundation for AI-enabled care in Europe.

Allonic
Allonic – Reimagining how robotics are made –
Allonic – Reimagining how robotics are made –
Allonic – Reimagining how robotics are made –
Allonic – Reimagining how robotics are made –
Allonic – Reimagining how robotics are made –
Allonic – Reimagining how robotics are made –
Allonic

Allonic is building a new manufacturing platform for robotic bodies, starting with dexterous hands, arms and end effectors. Its proprietary 3D Tissue Braiding process replaces manual assembly with automated continuous production, weaving fibres around a skeletal core to form joints, tendons and load bearing structures in one step. This allows robotic hardware to be produced directly from digital designs with sensors and wiring embedded, cutting build times from weeks to minutes while lowering cost and complexity.

Website Link

Our Thesis

Robotics intelligence is advancing faster than physical manufacturing can scale. Allonic tackles this bottleneck at the infrastructure level, enabling rapid iteration, safer designs and economically viable custom hardware. Early pilots and strong industrial demand validate the approach, alongside a founding team that blends robotics, materials science and software expertise. We believe Allonic can become critical infrastructure for the next generation of robotics and are excited to partner with the team as they reshape how robotic bodies are built.

Ameba

Revolutionising Global Supply Chains with AI: London-based Ameba has created an AI-driven platform that provides brands with data analytics tools and real-time insights, enabling them to transform complex supply chains into engines of growth and efficiency.

Website Link

Our Thesis

Supply chains are the backbone of commerce but remain outdated and inefficient, costing businesses up to 62% in losses during disruptions. Yet, reducing supply chain costs by just 4% can double profitability.

Ameba simplifies supply chain management by automating data extraction from scattered sources—emails, WhatsApps, PDFs, Excel sheets, and more—and consolidating it into one platform. Built on existing workflows, Ameba uses AI to translate raw data into actionable insights, giving teams real-time visibility across their entire supply chain. With instant updates on every product’s status, businesses can predict disruptions, respond to delays, manage costs, and address quality issues efficiently. Ameba’s AI also automates communication, updates, and alerts, driving faster decisions and greater efficiency. By turning fragmented data into meaningful insights, Ameba empowers brands to meet rapid consumer demands for faster, more cost-effective, and sustainable supply chains—transforming supply chains from bottlenecks into engines for growth.

Berlin-based Autarc is developing an AI-powered operating system for Europe's one-stop energy installers, accelerating the transition to fossil-free heating.

Website Link

Our Thesis

Heat pumps are central to Europe’s decarbonization strategy, with governments pushing for millions of installations by 2030. Yet, the industry remains highly fragmented – over 200,000 SMEs rely on outdated tools, making installations inefficient and slowing adoption.

Autarc is building the missing technology layer for these one-stop installers. In a first step, their AI-driven platform streamlines sales, design, and installation, cutting planning time of heat pump projects from 20 hours to less than 30 minutes using LiDAR-based data collection. By automating workflows, reducing errors, and improving efficiency, Autarc enables faster and more scalable deployment of heat pumps.

We see a massive opportunity in this underserved market. Autarc’s founding team combines deep industry expertise with strong execution speed, attracting top-tier talent. With powerful market tailwinds, a differentiated product, and early traction, Autarc is well-positioned to become a category-defining player in the energy transition.

Pave Space

PAVE Space is building the space logistics infrastructure to move satellites between orbits quickly and reliably. Founded in Lausanne in 2024, the company develops orbital transfer vehicles that transport satellites from low Earth orbit to higher energy orbits such as geostationary, medium Earth orbit and lunar trajectories in less than twenty four hours. Its flagship system attaches to satellites after launch and delivers them to their final orbit, replacing traditional orbit raising processes that can take six to twelve months. This enables operators to activate services faster, reduce risk and improve overall mission economics.

Website Link

Our Thesis

As launch becomes commoditised, orbital mobility is emerging as a critical bottleneck in the space economy. PAVE is addressing this by building the logistics layer that allows satellites to move, reposition and operate efficiently in orbit. The company enables faster time to revenue, new mission capabilities and better utilisation of existing infrastructure. Early commercial traction and a highly experienced founding team with deep expertise in rocket engineering further reinforce this opportunity.

Robert Lacher
General Partner

Robert is Founding Partner of Visionaries and an entrepreneur at heart. At Visionaries he has partnered with companies such as Lovable, n8n, Pigment, Miro, Tacto and Pave Space. Prior to Visionaries, he was the Founding Partner of La Famiglia, where he shaped the fund’s history and early vision including investments in companies such as Deel, Groq and Personio. He is also the founder of the fashion platform AMAZE, which he sold to Zalando in 2016. Earlier in his career, he worked at Boston Consulting Group and studied engineering and business at RWTH Aachen, the University of Cambridge, Imperial College London and Harvard University.

Robert has been featured on the Forbes Midas List Europe and was named Investor of the Year 2021 by the German Startup Association.

Judith Dada
General Partner

Judith is a General Partner at Visionaries. Previously, she was General Partner at La Famiglia, a European seed stage venture capital fund investing into B2B technology companies that enable or disrupt large industries. In 2024, La Famiglia merged with US-based VC firm General Catalyst, where she worked as Partner. Judith focuses on enterprise and AI-driven business models. Her portfolio includes companies like Personio, Parloa, Orbem, Buynomics and Ethon. She started her career at Facebook, managing Amazon Europe’s product and marketing strategy and Facebook’s VC Initiative.

Johann Butting

Legal Counsel

Daniel is the legal counsel at Visionaries. His work revolves around all legal aspects of Visionaries, in particular regarding investment deals.
Prior to joining Visionaries, Daniel was part of the Berlin and New York City teams of Noerr, a leading German law firm, for more than 4 years and advised startup founders and investors on venture capital and private equity transactions. He studied law at LMU Munich.

Roland Geeraedts
CFO & MD

Roland is the Chief Financial Officer at Visionaries. He and his team are responsible for all fund-specific topics such as finance, reporting, fund operations, tax, legal, and HR, as well guiding portfolio founders on financial matters. Prior to joining Visionaries, Roland was one of the first five employees of Moonfare, a fintech startup, where he was in charge of finance and operations. Roland helped scale the company to >250 employees, more than €2bn in Assets, a fully international structure including US operations, and raised over €150m in Seed to Series C funding rounds from tier 1 venture funds. Roland has a background in Transaction Advisory, mainly in the Technology / Private Equity space, having worked with EY for 9+ years in Germany and San Francisco (> 60 M&A transactions). He studied business administration at the University of Münster and University of Auckland, New Zealand.

Justus Hagebölling
VP Finance & Operations

Justus is VP Finance & Operations at Visionaries and leads various topics in the funds’ finance, legal, operations and tax functions. Before joining Visionaries, he worked as an Investment Manager at a Fintech startup in Berlin, and brings his finance expertise from several years as an Associate Director working in Asset Backed Finance at NORD/LB in New York. He holds an MBA from WHU with a specialization in Financial Management, including international modules at Kellogg School of Management and IIM Bangalore, and a Bachelor of Laws. Justus enjoys spending time traveling and is always in for a good basketball match.

Laura Hofmeister
Head of Events, Team Op.

Laura is Head of Events & Team Operations at Visionaries, overseeing all internal and external event operations as well as team operations, including feedback and development processes. In addition, she ensures a seamless flow of activities for Visionaries General Partners, Robert, Sebastian and Judith, managing their schedules across deals, board meetings, and other commitments. Laura holds a bachelor's degree in Business Administration with a focus on Marketing & Media. Prior to joining Visionaries, she worked with Boston Consulting Group and Lufthansa in Munich.

Robert Jäckle
Partner

Robert is a Partner at Visionaries. Joining the fund on day one, he has since co-led several Seed and Growth investments focussing on various verticals, including Fintech, Compliance, HR, Sustainability and Automation. Before joining Visionaries, he worked as an operator for HeyCar, helping to bring E-Commerce to used cars and in private equity at 3i. Robert studied Politics, Philosophy and Economics at the University of Oxford, where he was part of the University’s Tennis and Ski racing teams.

Venkat Kondragunta
Partner

VK is a Partner at Visionaries, and spends most of his time focussing on later-stage B2B investing at Visionaries. Prior to joining Visionaries in 2023, he was working in the early-stage ecosystem in Europe with stints as a founder, operator, and investor. VK studied Economics & Management at the University of Oxford. Outside of work VK plays the drums, can be found chasing down restaurant recommendations in London, and is also a long-suffering supporter of the Green Bay Packers.

Antonia Köhler
EA & Office Op. Lead

Antonia is Executive Assistant & Office Operations Lead at Visionaries, where she plays a pivotal role in ensuring seamless operations. She manages the schedules of our Visionaries Partners and oversees the Visionaries Loft in Berlin Mitte, Antonia also contributes significantly to the organisation of the on-site events and collaborates with Laura on various operational tasks. In her role, she handles a diverse range of responsibilities to support the team's day-to-day activities effectively. Before joining Visionaries, Antonia gained valuable experience as an Assistant and Office Manager at Oceans Apart and Hashtag You.

Betty Lu
VP Platform & Growth

Betty is VP Platform & Growth at Visionaries, where she drives portfolio support, platform strategy and company building efforts. Prior to joining Visionaries, Betty was a senior manager at Bain and Company in London and Toronto where she focused on strategy, organisational design and performance improvement. She has also led teams in commercial due diligence focused on the B2B Fintech space. Betty holds a MBA from the Kellogg School of Management, and studied at Queen's University and the University of Ljubljana. In her free time Betty loves to travel and is always looking for a new skiing, hiking or scuba diving destination.

Sahar Meghani
Partner

Sahar is a Partner at Visionaries. Based in London, Sahar leads our early growth fund and has made investments in Fintech, HR, Insurance, Health and Saas. Before joining Visionaries, Sahar held leading roles in Product, Business and Corporate Development roles at LinkedIn and Wonga. Prior to that she worked in Investment Banking at Greenhill & Co and in private equity at Insight Equity. Sahar is an avid cricket fan, has lived in 5 countries including Pakistan, UAE, Oman, US and the UK and currently resides in London with her husband and two daughters. Sahar studied Economics and Political Science at Wellesley College and has an MBA from Harvard Business School.

Luissa Schemuth
Analyst

Luissa spends her time on our early stage fund. Prior to Visionaries, she was with Tacto, a Visionaries Portfolio company, and worked closely with the founders on Business Development and Growth. Luissa was born and raised in Germany, holds a masters in Economics & Management of Innovation from Bocconi University and a bachelors in Psychology & Neuroscience from Maastricht University.

Linh Seidel
Head of Platform

Linh is Head of Platform Operations at Visionaries, where she works at the intersection of the investment and operations teams connecting the dots between our portfolio companies and LP net-work. Before joining Visionaries, Linh worked in the Finance, Data & Business Intelligence Team at OceansApart, supporting scaling performance analyses and internal processes during the company's rapid growth phase. Linh is an active team member of the 2hearts community team bringing together individuals with immigration backgrounds from Europe's tech industry. She holds a Master's degree from Grenoble Ecole de Management graduating as valedictorian.

Marton Sarkadi Nagy
Partner

Marton is a Partner at Visionaries and joined the firm on day one. He backs deeply technical founders building companies where engineering advantage compounds into enduring products, across AI, infrastructure and frontier hardware.
Before Visionaries, Marton was one of the first employees at TIER Mobility, helping scale the company from zero to more than €100M in revenue. He began his career in quantitative finance at Morgan Stanley and holds a Master’s degree in Mathematical Finance from MIT.

Katy Sexton Darby
VP Communications

Katy is Vice President of Communications at Visionaries, where she leads branding, marketing and PR across the fund and portfolio companies. Previously, she was Global Head of Comms & Marketing at Verlinvest, where she built the function from scratch and supported portfolio companies including Oatly, Tony’s Chocolonely and Vita Coco. Katy began her career at Milltown Partners, where she was one of the first 10 employees and helped build the firm’s US presence, including launching its San Francisco office. She advised high-growth tech companies, founders and investors on communications, reputation and public affairs.

Sandra Tur Mayor
Analyst

As part of the Finance & Ops. team, Sandra focuses on fund finance, reporting, and investor relations, while driving AI-powered automation initiatives to enhance the team's operational efficiency. Before joining Visionaries, she supported several departments of Metro AG's executive office and completed a Master's in Innovation & Entrepreneurship at ESMT Berlin, where she did a focus on finance at Imperial College London. Originally from Spain, Sandra holds a dual degree in International Business from University of Valencia and University of North Florida.

Isabella Yamamoto
Principal

Bella joined Visionaries in 2023 and focuses on early stage B2B investing. Prior to Visionaries, Bella worked at Remitly, a fintech unicorn, and was responsible for launching their business in new markets. She ran the DACH and APAC region and led their expansion into China. Whilst doing her MBA she worked at Accel where she focused on fintech and Open Source companies. Bella was born and raised in Tokyo. She holds an MBA from Harvard Business School and a bachelors from Cambridge University.
